links.outcome: Chatbot MIRA sub-score agreement with expert surgeons on nasal deformity photographs
links.effect: All four models differed significantly from experts on MIRA sub-scores (p<0.05); Grok 2 worst (p<0.001); only Claude 3.7 matched total MIRA score; ChatGPT 4o 70% accuracy on nose type.
links.quote: Detailed analysis of MIRA sub-scores showed a significant difference between chatbots and experts across all models (p < 0.05), including Claude.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of multimodal LLMs (ChatGPT 4o, Claude 3.7, Gemini 2.0, Grok 2) on analyzing standardized photographs of nasal deformities compared to expert scores, without testing specific deployment safeguards or practices.
